description.value:
One tap and you're off to Neverland.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks

Class: Iconic EQ Medium Melee • Skill: Melee Weapon • Range: Melee

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Whenever this weapon successfully performs an Aimed Shot targeted at the victim’s head and deals damage past their armor, the victim must make a DV15 Endurance Check or else immediately go Unconscious. If this weapon incurs a Critical Injury, it deals an additional 5 Bonus Damage (10 Total) and applies the effect of EMP Ammunition, but only disables 1 piece of the victim’s Cyberware. If damage dealt by this weapon would reduce a target to under 1 HP, the user can choose to leave their target Unconscious at 1 HP instead.

Fabrication: DV24 - 1,000eb - 2 Weeks
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
